descriptions.w3d_name_list_init_800c4598: Initialises a bounded name list: empty record vector and a zero limit.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_destroy_800c45b8: Deleting destructor of the name list: frees the record storage and, if requested, the list itself.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_clear_800c4604: Removes every name from the list and resets its limit to zero.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_count_800c4660: Returns the number of 33-byte name records in the list.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_pop_back_800c4d38: Copies the last name into a string and removes it; fails with 0x80004005 when the list is empty.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_back_800c4d9c: Copies the last name into a string without removing it; fails with 0x80004005 when the list is empty.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_freeze_800c4de8: Sets the list limit to the current number of names.
descriptions.w3d_name_list_trim_800c4e18: Drops names from the end until the list holds no more than its limit.
